_doc: NOT READ by the code. Copy the keys you need into picture_events.json (same folder) when a picture action lands on a different frame after the merge, then run `python mix.py`. Values: a frame (30 fps, may be fractional), a list of frames, the same dict shape as in picture_events_used.json, or null to drop that cue. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_flip_seqs_if_LEAD_P1_is_applied: WORLD-EXT poseFlip ones FLAP_SEQ(4, tons14-2) + tens FLAP_SEQ(1, tons14+3): [target, start - tons14]
_bubble_out_if_CHAR_pops_it_on_Then: CHAR A1-P2 option: pop the hook bubble out at ~64 (2 f shrink) instead of 106
_shutter_3_if_no_flash: drop the shot-3 shutter if CHAR does not add the background photographer flash at ~234
_whistle_3_if_no_o_mouth: drop the innocent whistle if CHAR does not key the 'whistle' o-mouth into the 234-241 gap
_raven_extras: CHAR A1-ADD raven moments, if they are animated and in frame
_tumble_10_if_moved: CHAR A1-P1 asked to move the shot-10 tumbleweed to 1115-1130 (WORLD-EXT's list keeps it at 1092-1112)
_crowd_if_LEAD_keeps_the_round1_timing: if the Sign B crowd still grabs at pct8-34 and pockets ~pct8-26
